name: 599. Anthropic's US and fast multipliers published only under provider_specific_entry are billed: a US request at 1.1x and a fast request at 6x the standard rates (provider-specific multipliers)

item.name: 599.1 anthropic/fixture-claude-us POST /v1/chat/completions served in the US is billed at 1.1x (provider-specific multipliers)

exec: pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });

// The fixture answers with usage.inference_geo us. The row publishes the 1.1 multiplier only as provider_specific_entry.us (claude-sonnet-5, 14 Nov 2026), which the fork dropped at sync before TXE-7422, billing 1.0x.
pm.sendRequest({ url: BASE + '/api/logs?limit=50', method: 'GET', header: { 'X-Bifrost-Setup-Token': token } }, function (err, res) {
var row = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.id === requestId; })[0];

pm.test('the log row of this request is readable', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code, res.text()).to.equal(200); pm.expect(row, 'no log row for ' + requestId).to.be.an('object'); });

pm.test('the logged cost is (12 x $3e-06 + 3 x $1.5e-05) x 1.1, the US multiplier', function () { pm.expect(row && (row.cost || 0), JSON.stringify(row && { cost: row.cost })).to.be.closeTo(8.91e-05, 1e-12); });

item.name: 599.2 anthropic/fixture-claude-fast POST /v1/chat/completions served in fast mode is billed at 6x (provider-specific multipliers)

exec: pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });

// The fixture answers with usage.speed fast. The row publishes fast 6 only under provider_specific_entry and no *_fast rate (claude-opus-4-7-20260416), so before TXE-7422 a fast request billed the standard rate.
pm.sendRequest({ url: BASE + '/api/logs?limit=50', method: 'GET', header: { 'X-Bifrost-Setup-Token': token } }, function (err, res) {
var row = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.id === requestId; })[0];

pm.test('the log row of this request is readable', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code, res.text()).to.equal(200); pm.expect(row, 'no log row for ' + requestId).to.be.an('object'); });

pm.test('the logged cost is 6 x (12 x $5e-06 + 3 x $2.5e-05), the fast-mode multiplier', function () { pm.expect(row && (row.cost || 0), JSON.stringify(row && { cost: row.cost })).to.be.closeTo(0.00081, 1e-12); });
